shell_normal_measure: area-weighted actual outer triangles; not Blender vertex normal or surface shortest distance
limits: Self BVH excludes adjacent/shared-vertex folds. External containment samples are finite, not exhaustive. Triangle contact counts not penetration measure. No source acceptance.
